cases.query: EVALUATE ROW("a", LEFT("Hello", 2), "b", LEFT("Hello"), "c", LEFT("Hi", 10), "d", RIGHT("Hello", 3), "e", RIGHT("Hello"), "f", LEFT(BLANK(), 2), "g", LEFT(12345, 2), "h", RIGHT("abc", 0))
EVALUATE ROW("a", LEFT("Hello", -1))
EVALUATE ROW("a", MID("Hello", 2, 3), "b", MID("Hello", 9, 3), "c", MID("Hello", 4, 50), "d", MID("Hello", 1, 0), "e", MID(BLANK(), 1, 2))
EVALUATE ROW("a", MID("Hello", 0, 1))
EVALUATE ROW("len", LEN("héllo"), "lb", LEN(BLANK()), "ln", LEN(12345), "up", UPPER("abC"), "lo", LOWER("AbC"), "ub", UPPER(BLANK()), "ln2", LEN(1.50), "lb2", LEN(TRUE()))
EVALUATE ROW("a", TRIM("  a   b  "), "b", TRIM("a"), "c", TRIM(BLANK()), "d", LEN(TRIM(" x ")))
EVALUATE ROW("a", EXACT("a", "A"), "b", EXACT("a", "a"), "c", EXACT(1, "1"), "d", EXACT(BLANK(), ""))
EVALUATE ROW("a", FIND("l", "Hello"), "b", FIND("l", "Hello", 4), "c", FIND("L", "Hello", 1, 0), "d", FIND("", "abc"), "e", FIND("a", "abc", 1, BLANK()))
EVALUATE ROW("a", FIND("L", "Hello"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", SEARCH("L", "Hello"), "b", SEARCH("h*o", "Say Hello"), "c", SEARCH("~?", "Why? Because"), "d", SEARCH("zz", "abc", 1, -1), "e", SEARCH("b?d", "Abcd bad"), "f", SEARCH("", "abc"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", REPLACE("abcdef", 2, 3, "X"), "b", REPLACE("abc", 5, 1, "X"), "c", REPLACE("abc", 1, 0, "X"), "d", REPLACE(BLANK(), 1, 1, "X"))

EVALUATE ROW("a", SUBSTITUTE("a-b-c", "-", "+"), "b", SUBSTITUTE("a-b-c", "-", "+", 2), "c", SUBSTITUTE("Aa", "a", "x"), "d", SUBSTITUTE("abc", "", "x"), "e", SUBSTITUTE("abc", "b", BLANK()), "f", SUBSTITUTE("a-b", "-", "+", 5))
EVALUATE ROW("a", REPT("ab", 3), "b", REPT("ab", 0), "c", REPT("", 5), "d", REPT("x", 2.9))
EVALUATE ROW("a", REPT("a", -1))

EVALUATE ROW("a", CONCATENATE("a", 1), "b", CONCATENATE(BLANK(), BLANK()), "c", CONCATENATE("a", BLANK()), "d", "a" & BLANK(), "e", BLANK() & BLANK(), "f", COMBINEVALUES("|", "a", 2, BLANK()), "g", COMBINEVALUES(",", BLANK()))

EVALUATE ROW("a", CONCATENATEX(Product, Product[Product], ", ", Product[ListPrice], DESC), "b", CONCATENATEX(FILTER(Product, Product[Category] = "Accessories"), Product[Product], "+", Product[Product]), "c", CONCATENATEX(Product, Product[ListPrice], ";", Product[ListPrice], ASC), "d", CONCATENATEX(FILTER(Product, FALSE()), Product[Product], ","))
EVALUATE ROW("a", CONCATENATEX(Product, Product[Product], "|", Product[Category], ASC, Product[Product], DESC))
EVALUATE ROW("a", UNICODE("A"), "b", UNICHAR(66), "c", UNICODE("é"), "d", UNICHAR(8364), "e", UNICODE("abc"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", UNICODE(""))
EVALUATE ROW("a", VALUE("42"), "b", VALUE("1,234.5"), "c", VALUE("50%"), "d", VALUE(" 7 "), "e", VALUE("$12"), "f", VALUE("(5)"), "g", VALUE("1E3"), "h", VALUE(5), "i", VALUE(TRUE()))
EVALUATE ROW("a", VALUE("abc"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", VALUE(BLANK()), "b", VALUE(""))

EVALUATE ROW("a", FORMAT(1234.5, "#,##0.00"), "b", FORMAT(0.256, "0.0%"), "c", FORMAT(0.256, "Percent"), "d", FORMAT(5, "000"), "e", FORMAT(1234.567, "0.00"), "f", FORMAT(1234.567, "#,0"), "g", FORMAT(-5, "0.0"), "h", FORMAT(0.5, "#.##"), "i", FORMAT(1234, "General Number"), "j", FORMAT(1234.5, "Standard"), "k", FORMAT(1234.5, "Fixed"), "l", FORMAT(1234.5, "Currency"), "m", FORMAT(-1234.5, "Currency"))

EVALUATE ROW("a", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "yyyy-MM-dd"), "b", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "MMMM d, yyyy"), "c", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "Short Date"), "d", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "dddd"), "e", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "MMM"), "f", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "dd/MM/yy"), "g", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "Long Date"), "h", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "General Date"), "i", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "Medium Date"))

EVALUATE ROW("a", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 7, 9), "HH:mm:ss"), "b", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 7, 9), "h:mm AM/PM"), "c", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 7, 9), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), "d", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 7, 9), "General Date"), "e", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 7, 9), "Long Time"), "f", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5) + TIME(14, 7, 9), "Short Time"))

EVALUATE ROW("a", FORMAT(TRUE(), "Yes/No"), "b", FORMAT(TRUE(), "General"), "c", FORMAT("abc", ">"), "d", FORMAT("ABC", "<"), "e", FORMAT(BLANK(), "0"), "f", FORMAT(1, "On/Off"), "g", FORMAT(0, "True/False"), "h", FORMAT(1234.5, ""))
EVALUATE ROW("a", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), ""), "b", FORMAT(1234.5, ""), "c", FORMAT(TRUE(), ""))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "a", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Product), LEFT(Product[Product], 1) = "T"), "len", SUMX(Product, LEN(Product[Product]))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
